briefdescription.para: No interference, go ahead and assign.

detaileddescription.para: There are interfering virtual registers assigned to PhysReg or its aliases. This interference could be resolved by unassigning those other virtual registers.
A fixed live range is in the way, typically argument registers for a call. This can't be resolved by unassigning other virtual registers.
The live range is crossing an instruction with a regmask operand that doesn't preserve PhysReg. This typically means VirtReg is live across a call, and PhysReg isn't call-preserved.

briefdescription.para: Invalidate cached interference queries after modifying virtual register live ranges.

detaileddescription.para: Interference checks may return stale information unless caches are invalidated.

briefdescription.para: Check for interference before assigning VirtReg to PhysReg.

detaileddescription.para: If this function returns IK_Free, it is legal to assign(VirtReg, PhysReg). When there is more than one kind of interference, the InterferenceKind with the highest enum value is returned.

briefdescription.para: Check for interference in the segment [Start, End) that may prevent assignment to PhysReg.

detaileddescription.para: If this function returns true, there is interference in the segment [Start, End) of some other interval already assigned to PhysReg. If this function returns false, PhysReg is free at the segment [Start, End).

briefdescription.para: Check for interference in the segment [Start, End) that may prevent assignment to PhysReg, like checkInterference.

detaileddescription.para: Returns a lane mask of which lanes of the physical register interfere in the segment [Start, End) of some other interval already assigned to PhysReg.
If this function returns LaneBitmask::getNone(), PhysReg is completely free at the segment [Start, End).
This will mark VirtReg's live range as occupied in the LiveRegMatrix and update VirtRegMap. The live range is expected to be available in PhysReg.
Assuming that VirtReg was previously assigned to a PhysReg, this undoes the assignment and updates VirtRegMap accordingly.

briefdescription.para: Returns true if the given PhysReg has any live intervals assigned.

detaileddescription.para: Return true if VirtReg crosses a regmask operand that clobbers PhysReg. If PhysReg is null, check if VirtReg crosses any regmask operands.
Return true if VirtReg overlaps a fixed assignment of one of PhysRegs's register units.

briefdescription.para: Query a line of the assigned virtual register matrix directly.

detaileddescription.para: Use MCRegUnitIterator to enumerate all regunits in the desired PhysReg. This returns a reference to an internal Query data structure that is only valid until the next query() call.

briefdescription.para: Directly access the live interval unions per regunit.

detaileddescription.para: This returns an array indexed by the regunit number.
